entities.summary: Anne-Emmanuel-Ferdinand-François de Croÿ Prince of Solre and Duke of Croÿ was a French soldier of the 18th century who attained the rank of Maréchal de camp. He served as a member of the National Constituent Assembly of 1789 representing the Bailiwick of Le Quesnoy, Hainaut.

entities.summary: Anne-Emmanuel-Ferdinand-François de Croÿ Prince of Solre and Duke of Croÿ was a French soldier of the 18th century who attained the rank of Maréchal de camp. He served as a member of the National Constituent Assembly of 1789 representing the Bailiwick of Le Quesnoy, Hainaut.
